title: x509 generator: --check mislabels safety violations as staleness
description: Codereview edge-pass P4 on bedw.19. test/vectors/generate_x509_cert_profile.py:408 catches RuntimeError from read_bounded_exact and reports 'out-of-date vector file', but that RuntimeError also covers tamper/safety refusals (ownership/symlink/racy-replacement) per atomic_json.py. Exit code still 1 (no silent pass) but the diagnosis is wrong. Fix: catch FileNotFoundError alone; let RuntimeError propagate or print a distinct message. (Existing generators share this pattern; fix here or sweep all.)
